completenessChecks.rafIntervalCountReason: 120 measured rAF starting timestamps yield 119 consecutive intervals; this is not a missing update
completenessChecks.topLevelElapsedField: Both run.initial.elapsed and run.final.elapsed stay zero in manual mode; use motionReport.time and physics counters for actual progression

timingDefinitions.cpu: Wall interval around _stepNoReport(1/60), including native motion, guide physics, attachments/camera and rendering submission; not exclusive CPU busy time or pure solver time
timingDefinitions.gpu: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 TIME_ELAPSED interval begins before the combined CPU update and ends after submission. It can include GPU idle gaps while CPU work prepares later commands; it is not exclusive GPU execution time
timingDefinitions.raf: Intervals between measured requestAnimationFrame callback starting timestamps; reflects pacing observed in this test session, not independently measured display presentations or hardware throughput
timingDefinitions.wall: Includes waiting between callbacks. Asynchronous GPU query drain follows the end timestamp and is excluded
timingDefinitions.addition: CPU and GPU intervals may overlap. They cannot be added into a frame budget, and neither can be added to the independent clothing timings from a different Node/CPU environment

arithmeticFromSummariesNotNewMeasurement.boundaryInterpretation: 72 ms remainder is compatible with the last measured update and endpoint overhead; it is a consistency check, not reconstruction of raw samples

rawDataLimit.availableData: Only summary count/mean/p50/p95/min/max and run endpoint reports are archived
rawDataLimit.independentVerificationPossible: Count consistency, range ordering, expected simulation progress, source instrumentation checks and relationships between summary totals
rawDataLimit.independentVerificationNotPossible: Recompute browser means/percentiles from original values, inspect time ordering/outliers, pair CPU and GPU samples, or independently diagnose the long rAF intervals
rawDataLimit.contrastWithClothRecord: Cloth R02 retains its 720 raw CPU samples and was independently recomputed. Do not make the same raw-data verification claim for this browser file.

safeConclusions: 原生单人身体＋F13密发及现有导向物理在该浏览器完成了20步预热和120步采样，没有记录到异常或未完成GPU查询。
浏览器报告RTX4070TiSUPER/ANGLE D3D11，绘制缓冲1425×1506、DPR1.5；结果只描述这一实际会话与此固定动作设置。
本次CPU更新与提交区间均值78.69ms、P95 119.30ms；GPU查询时间区间均值32.37ms、P95 84.77ms，属于不同且可能重叠的时间区间。
采样的2秒模拟耗费116.918秒wall time，rAF间隔均值981.90ms/P95 1067.70ms；延迟来源尚未确证，必须连同数字报告。
可以据此优先剖析身体/头发的逐步更新、同步和提交成本；目前没有建立渲染吞吐量、用户设备容量或完整多人场景的性能上限。
unsupportedConclusions: 以1000/CPU均值、1000/GPU均值或1000/(CPU+GPU均值)作为实测FPS。
把本浏览器CPU/GPU区间和另一容器的衣物CPU时间相加得到完整NPC帧耗时。
仅因GPU区间小于CPU区间就确定纯CPU瓶颈、GPU利用率或优化后的可达FPS。
120次采样已被逐帧原始数据复核，或rAF异常已经证明来自浏览器/网络/远程环境中的某一具体原因。
F13导向物理的完成证明最新结构线已通过验收，或证明全部显示发丝独立物理及完整碰撞正确。
